title: useTimeout Hook
description:
Implement a `useTimeout` hook that fires `callback` once after `delay` ms and returns `{ reset, clear }` controls. Calling `reset()` cancels any pending timer and starts a fresh one. Calling `clear()` cancels without restarting.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { reset, clear } = useTimeout(() => setSaved(true), 2000);
```
ai_context: Learners often forget to reset the timer inside reset() by clearing the old timeout first, leading to multiple simultaneous timers and callback firing more than once.
